June 4,  2018 

Scott S.  Harris, Clerk 
Supreme Court of the United States 
One First Street, N.E. 
Washington, D.C.  20543 

Re: 

Lamps Plus. lnc.  et al.  v.  Varela, 
No.  17-988 

Dear Mr.  Harris: 

The  Court  granted  the  petition  for  a  writ  of certiorari  in  the  above-captioned  case  on 
April 30, 2018.  Petitioners' brief on the merits is  currently due June  14,  2018.  Because of other 
matters  with  pressing  deadlines  and  in  light  of  the  summer  recess,  petitioners  respectfully 
request, pursuant to Rule 30.4, a 25-day extension of time in which to  file their brief and the joint 
appendix  and  a  22-day  extension  of time  for  respondent  to  file  his  brief.  The  parties  have 
agreed, subject to the Court's approval, to  the following proposed briefing schedule: 

•  Petitioners' Brief and Joint Appendix:  Monday, July 9, 2018 

•  Respondent's Brief: 

Thursday, August 30, 2018 

•  Petitioners'  Reply Brief: 

Monday, October 1, 2018 (or earlier if 
required by Rule 25.3) 

Sincerely, 

Andrew J.  Pincus 

Mayer Brown  LLP operates in combination with other Mayer Brown entities (the "Mayer Brown  Practices"),  which have offices in North  America, 
Europe and Asia and are associated with Tauil  & Chequer Advogados,  a Brazilian law partnership.
